title: The M-tile-sharing citation points at the vd4dots kernel but is used to explain a +repack measurement
severity: minor
kind: reproducibility

claimed impact: The conclusion stands unchanged. A reader who checks the citation against a `+repack` build finds those lines preprocessed away and cannot confirm the claim. Fix is a one-line change to cite 2120-2132 (or to cite both, since the shape holds in both).

| +repack to +prefetch | **1.07x** | 1.60x |
| +prefetch to +vd4dots | **2.75x** | 3.54x |
| **total** | **20.67x** | **12.64x** |

Over prefill's full set of 10 optimizable nodes the totals are 6.62x / 1.06x /
2.58x = **18.15x**, against decode's 10-node figure of 12.20x.

Per layer:

| | gemm | gemv |
|---|---:|---:|
| layer 6 (SSM), 6 nodes | **20.60x** | 12.53x |
| layer 7 (attention), 7 nodes | **17.65x** | 12.17x |

Layer 7 is lower on both paths because it owns the two 1024-row tensors.

This reproduces the 4B prefill result (6.11x / 1.04x / 2.46x) on a model 6.5x
larger with a different architecture. Prefill takes its win from the **layout**;
decode takes its win from **prefetch and the dot instruction**.

The absolute cycles show it without any ratio. On `ffn_gate` at `+repack`:

| path | tokens | cycles | per token |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| decode | 2 | 73,356,044 | 36,678,022 |
| prefill | 4 | **45,434,691** | **11,358,673** |

Prefill does twice the tokens in 62% of the cycles -- 3.2x cheaper per token --
because the gemm loads each weight vector once and fires four dots against it
(`arch/riscv/repack.cpp:1967-1972`), while the gemv reloads it per token.

## Why prefill loses its edge on small tensors: a scalar activation quantizer

Measured on Bonsai-4B, whose layer-7 nodes `attn_q`, `attn_v`, `attn_k`,
`ffn_gate` and `ffn_up` all share `ne0 = 2560` and differ only in row count, so
a node's cost splits cleanly into a per-call constant and a per-64-row-tile
term. Fitting `cycles = F + T * tiles` (gemv residuals within 1.1%):

| | fixed per call `F` | per tile `T` | per tile **per token** |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| gemv `d4` (2 tok) | 39,491 | 21,638 | 10,819 |
| gemm `d4` (4 tok) | 489,581 | 23,036 | **5,759** |

In steady state the gemm is **1.88x more efficient per token**, exactly as the
M-tile sharing predicts. But it carries **12.4x the per-call fixed cost**, and
that constant is what decides the small nodes: `F` is 59% of 4B `attn_v`'s
total and only 12% of its `ffn_gate`. The same mechanism is why 27B `attn_v`
and `attn_k` stop at 11.40x while every larger node reaches 18.9-22.4x.

`F` is not part of the kernel. Fitting the same model to every repack variant:

| variant | gemm `F` | gemm `T` | gemv `F` | gemv `T` |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `baseline` | 398,003 | 80,915 | 13,379 | 133,082 |
| `prefetch` | 441,355 | 76,544 | 27,294 | 85,084 |
| `d4` | 489,581 | 23,036 | 39,491 | 21,638 |

`T` collapses 3.5x (gemm) and 6.2x (gemv) as the kernel improves; `F` stays put,
and stays an order of magnitude apart between the two paths. It is the shared
activation path, and the source says what it is. `forward_mul_mat` quantizes
activations before the kernel runs (`repack.cpp:4456-4469`), and the routine it
picks depends on the token count:

- **4 tokens** (`ne11 - ne11 % 4 == 4`) take
  `ggml_quantize_mat_t<1, GGML_TYPE_Q8_0>`, which selects
  `ggml_quantize_mat_q8_0_4x1_generic` -- a **pure scalar** loop
  (`repack.cpp:51`, its own comment says `// scalar`): per 32-column block, 128
  `fabsf` for the amax scan plus 128 `roundf` plus the de-interleave index
  arithmetic. Its vector twin is gated behind `__riscv_zvfh`, and the
  measurement build sets `-DGGML_RV_ZVFH=OFF`.
- **2 tokens** are not a multiple of 4, so they fall through to `from_float` =
  `quantize_row_q8_0`, which **is** RVV-vectorized on RISC-V
  (`arch/riscv/quants.c:32`, gated only on `__riscv_v`).

So decode gets a vector quantizer and prefill gets a scalar one. That is the
whole 12.4x fixed-cost gap, and at ~490K cycles per node it is the largest
single item in a small prefill matmul -- bigger than the kernel it feeds.
Vectorizing it is the clearest remaining prefill win.

# Bonsai-27B prefill: measured cycles per MUL_MAT node, SSM and attention layers

The prefill/gemm counterpart of `profiling_gemv_27b.md`, which covers the same
27B nodes on the decode/gemv path. Same engine, same nodes, same four build
stages -- `nrows=4` instead of `nrows=2`.

Generated 2026-08-31. Every figure is a cycle-accurate RTL measurement of one
MUL_MAT node; nothing here is inferred except layer 7's three `ffn_*` rows,
which are noted where they appear. Regenerate any table with
`MODEL=27b NODES="..." bash sweep.sh --md`.

## Setup

| | |
|---|---|
| Engine | `vsim:ax46mpv_fpga_l3` -- VLEN 1024, 1 hart, 32 KB L1D, no L2, 2 MB L3 |
| Model | `Bonsai-27B-Q1_0.gguf`, qwen35, 64 layers, 3.80 GB, 1.125 bits/weight |
| Mode | andesim hybrid, marker trigger, `--no-mmap --mem-size 12G -t 1` |
| Path | prefill / gemm, `nrows=4` (asserted per leg from the `[roi]` line) |
| Layer mix | `full_attention_interval=4`: 48 SSM layers, 16 attention layers |

Every layer in the model is one of two kinds, so measuring one of each covers
the whole model: **layer 6** is an SSM layer (48 of 64) and **layer 7** is an
attention layer (16 of 64).

| name | flags | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `pristine` | `GGML_CPU_REPACK=OFF` | upstream llama.cpp |
| `baseline` | repack ON, `Q1_PREFETCH_DIST=0` | + row-parallel 64x1 repack |
| `prefetch` | repack ON, `Q1_PREFETCH_DIST=1` | + zicbop prefetch = **standard RVV** |
| `d4` | + `GGML_RV_XANDESVDOT=ON` | + `nds.vd4dots.vv` |

## Layer 6 -- an SSM layer (48 of 64)

| layer | node | ne0 x ne1 | weights | upstream | +repack | +prefetch | +vd4dots | total |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 6 | `attn_qkv` | 5120 x 10240 | 52,428,800 | 181,789,774 | 27,118,723 | 25,385,875 | 8,976,703 | 20.25x |
| 6 | `ssm_alpha` | 5120 x 48 | 245,760 | 936,969 | 939,289 | 939,798 | 938,688 | 1.00x |
| 6 | `ssm_beta` | 5120 x 48 | 245,760 | 949,957 | 947,611 | 947,471 | 945,595 | 1.00x |
| 6 | `attn_gate` | 5120 x 6144 | 31,457,280 | 109,087,879 | 16,595,177 | 15,548,729 | 5,708,128 | 19.11x |
| 6 | `ssm_out` | 6144 x 5120 | 31,457,280 | 122,621,082 | 17,362,812 | 16,461,292 | 6,500,681 | 18.86x |
| 6 | `ffn_gate` | 5120 x 17408 | 89,128,960 | 309,587,645 | 45,434,691 | 42,133,870 | 14,351,598 | 21.57x |
| 6 | `ffn_up` | 5120 x 17408 | 89,128,960 | 309,915,506 | 45,437,135 | 42,135,770 | 14,349,546 | 21.60x |
| 6 | `ffn_down` | 17408 x 5120 | 89,128,960 | 382,982,019 | 47,880,022 | 44,881,677 | 17,064,993 | 22.44x |
| | **LAYER** | | **383,221,760** | **1,417,870,831** | **201,715,460** | **188,434,482** | **68,835,932** | |

Geometric mean over the layer's 6 optimizable nodes: **20.60x**. `ssm_alpha`
and `ssm_beta` are excluded from every average in this document, for the reason
given directly below.

Per-stage speedup:

| layer | node | +repack | +prefetch | +vd4dots | **total** |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 6 | `attn_qkv` | 6.70x | 1.07x | 2.83x | **20.25x** |
| 6 | `ssm_alpha` | 1.00x | 1.00x | 1.00x | **1.00x** |
| 6 | `ssm_beta` | 1.00x | 1.00x | 1.00x | **1.00x** |
| 6 | `attn_gate` | 6.57x | 1.07x | 2.72x | **19.11x** |
| 6 | `ssm_out` | 7.06x | 1.05x | 2.53x | **18.86x** |
| 6 | `ffn_gate` | 6.81x | 1.08x | 2.94x | **21.57x** |
| 6 | `ffn_up` | 6.82x | 1.08x | 2.94x | **21.60x** |
| 6 | `ffn_down` | 8.00x | 1.07x | 2.63x | **22.44x** |

`ssm_alpha` and `ssm_beta` are the only two tensors in the model the kernel is
never applied to. The dispatch gate at `repack.cpp:4889` requires
`cur->ne[1] % 64 == 0` -- the row-parallel kernel puts 64 rows in 64 vector
lanes -- and both have 48 rows. The `if` is false, no repack happens, and all
four builds run the identical stock kernel, which is why their four cycle
counts agree to 0.3% and their speedup is exactly 1.00x. Nothing was applied,
so they measure nothing about the optimization and are left out of every
average here. They are 0.12% of the layer's weights; padding them to 64 rows
would bring them in.

## Layer 7 -- an attention layer (16 of 64)

| layer | node | ne0 x ne1 | weights | upstream | +repack | +prefetch | +vd4dots | total |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 7 | `attn_q` | 5120 x 12288 | 62,914,560 | 221,201,927 | 32,315,274 | 30,372,677 | 10,662,439 | 20.75x |
| 7 | `attn_v` | 5120 x 1024 | 5,242,880 | 18,582,438 | 3,434,839 | 3,268,543 | 1,630,251 | 11.40x |
| 7 | `attn_k` | 5120 x 1024 | 5,242,880 | 18,575,271 | 3,432,110 | 3,268,500 | 1,628,900 | 11.40x |
| 7 | `attn_output` | 6144 x 5120 | 31,457,280 | 119,759,239 | 17,118,167 | 16,275,722 | 6,337,136 | 18.90x |
| 7 | `ffn_gate` | 5120 x 17408 | 89,128,960 | 309,587,645 | 45,434,691 | 42,133,870 | 14,351,598 | 21.57x |
| 7 | `ffn_up` | 5120 x 17408 | 89,128,960 | 309,915,506 | 45,437,135 | 42,135,770 | 14,349,546 | 21.60x |
| 7 | `ffn_down` | 17408 x 5120 | 89,128,960 | 382,982,019 | 47,880,022 | 44,881,677 | 17,064,993 | 22.44x |
| | **LAYER** | | **372,244,480** | **1,380,604,045** | **241,152,929** | **225,336,152** | **66,024,863** | |

Geometric mean over the layer's 7 nodes: **17.65x** -- lower than layer 6's
20.60x, but not for the same reason: layer 7 has no gate failures. It owns
`attn_v` and `attn_k`, the two 1024-row tensors that stop at 11.40x because the
per-call activation quantize dominates when there are only 16 row tiles to
spread it over.

Layer 7's three `ffn_*` rows are the same tensor shapes as layer 6's and are
carried from them, exactly as `profiling_gemv_27b.md` does for decode. The
carry is sound: `ffn_gate` and `ffn_up` are themselves the same shape and were
measured **0.11%** apart at upstream and **0.01%** apart at `d4`.

Per-stage speedup:

| layer | node | +repack | +prefetch | +vd4dots | **total** |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 7 | `attn_q` | 6.85x | 1.06x | 2.85x | **20.75x** |
| 7 | `attn_v` | 5.41x | 1.05x | 2.00x | **11.40x** |
| 7 | `attn_k` | 5.41x | 1.05x | 2.01x | **11.40x** |
| 7 | `attn_output` | 7.00x | 1.05x | 2.57x | **18.90x** |
| 7 | `ffn_gate` | 6.81x | 1.08x | 2.94x | **21.57x** |
| 7 | `ffn_up` | 6.82x | 1.08x | 2.94x | **21.60x** |
| 7 | `ffn_down` | 8.00x | 1.07x | 2.63x | **22.44x** |

## Where the prefill speedup comes from

All figures are geometric means over nodes, with `ssm_alpha`/`ssm_beta`
excluded. Decode has only five nodes measured at all four stages, so the
head-to-head below uses **those same five on both sides** -- `attn_gate`,
`ssm_out`, `ffn_gate`, `ffn_up`, `ffn_down`:

| step | 27B gemm (prefill) | 27B gemv (decode) |
|---|---:|---:|
| upstream to +repack | **7.04x** | 2.24x |
| +repack to +prefetch | **1.07x** | 1.60x |
